sources.title: Pokémon TCG: HS—Triumphant official Card-Dex
sources.verification: Electrode's Energymite says to choose any number of Energy cards and attach them to the player's Pokémon in any way the player likes.
sources.supportsZh: 作为逐张能量可分配给不同己方公开宝可梦的历史卡文建模例子；不表示 Electrode 或任何历史卡已经可在本模组对战。

sources.title: Play! Pokémon Competitive Pokémon Rules and Formats
sources.verification: The official index provides maintained entry points for rulebooks, tournament rules, legality notices and errata.
sources.supportsZh: 用于持续核验当前规则包；索引页本身不被当作历史单卡的完整时序裁定。

retrievalLimitations: No PTCG Live behavior, Chinese translation, image or community source is used as rule authority.
The Card-Dex is used as a historical international text example, not a current Standard legality assertion.
Every real card remains unavailable until its complete official text, timing and legality are audited.
implementationLimits: Supports only per-card distribution of one filtered Basic Energy selection across the controller's publicly visible in-play Pokémon.
The server issues private card candidates, revalidates every source card and host, and atomically attaches only after every card has a legal host.
Does not implement multiple filter groups, movement of already attached Energy, replacement effects, special energy exceptions, target-bound costs, or the historical Electrode card.
